args.text:
Well, you’ve just joined a cracking bunch of people doing work that'd inspire anyone.

We've got a chance like no one's had before to drag our government into the digital age and change the way it works. That chance is what brings us all together, and it's what keeps us fired up about the job.

The people you'll be working with here are seriously talented and dedicated, and they care heaps about making a difference. You'll find the culture's strong, too: inclusive, transparent, respectful, and upbeat.

Part of your job is being a good mate to our colleagues right across government. We're having a red-hot go at leading the way in technology, sure, but also at being the modern, collaborative, diverse culture we want to see. If we can't work with colleagues across government, we can't make a difference, simple as that.

We try to be strategic and practical at the same time – strategic in always keeping the bigger opportunity front of mind, and practical in keeping our feet on the ground with the nitty gritty of actually getting particular projects done. And we're dead set on working in an open, iterative and user-centred way, with a strong focus on delivery.

We want the organisation itself to be as agile and user-centric as our projects, drawing on everyone's ideas and insights. So if you spot any way we can do better, give us a yell.

Thanks again for putting your talents into serving the public. We’re stoked to have you on the TTS team.
